# Test fixtures — SYNTHETIC DATA

Every file in this directory is **made up** for tests and `npm run snapshot:fixtures`.
The numbers are deliberately round (SOL = $100, BTC = $50,000) and the tokens
(FIXDOG, FIXCAT, FIXFROG) do not exist. Nothing here is market data.

The shapes follow the public API responses of CoinGecko, DexScreener,
GeckoTerminal, Jupiter Price v3, DefiLlama, alternative.me and Solana JSON-RPC.
